translations.onboarding.title: Welcome to D3dx Skin Manager
translations.onboarding.language.title: Language / 语言
translations.onboarding.language.body: Choose your preferred language — you can change it any time in Settings. / 选择界面语言，之后可随时在设置中更改。
translations.onboarding.welcome.title: Your mod library, organized
translations.onboarding.welcome.body: D3dx Skin Manager keeps your mods compressed and organized, fixes hashes after game updates, and deploys the ones you pick. Your model importer (XXMI) handles launching the game and loading them.
translations.onboarding.welcome.point1: Import, categorize, tag, and preview your whole mod collection.
translations.onboarding.welcome.point2: Load a mod to deploy it into the game's Mods folder; XXMI runs it.
translations.onboarding.location.title: Where should mods deploy?
translations.onboarding.location.body: Point at your XXMI Launcher folder and pick the game importer. Loaded mods deploy into that importer's Mods folder so the game sees them.
translations.onboarding.location.skipHint: No XXMI yet? Skip this — mods stay app-managed and you can set the location later in Settings.
translations.onboarding.done.title: You're all set
translations.onboarding.done.body: That's everything. A few ways to start:
translations.onboarding.done.point1: Drag a mod archive or folder onto the window to import it.
translations.onboarding.done.point2: Organize mods into categories and tag them for fast filtering.
translations.onboarding.done.point3: Select a mod and Load it to deploy; switch variants anytime.
